issues: Document is a 'Поверка средств измерений (единство измерений)' scope (102-ФЗ), not the standard ОКПД2/ТН ВЭД accreditation-scope table: it has no norm_doc/okpd2/tnved columns per row, only the overarching standard '102-ФЗ Об обеспечении единства измерений' shown once at the top, applied here to all rows. Columns present: N П/П, Измерения, Тип (группа) средств измерений, диапазон измерений, погрешность и (или) неопределенность, Примечание. Section header '2. Поверка средств измерений (ГВФ)' is a category label, not a ТР ТС heading, so tr_section is null throughout. Row 2.1 lists 4 measurement ranges (мкм, мм/с, м/с2, Гц) split into 4 JSON rows, but the source lists only 3 погрешность values for the 4 ranges — the 4th range (0–2000 Гц) has no corresponding accuracy value printed in the PDF (not omitted by us, not present in source). Pages metadata report rotation=90 but rendered pixmaps were already upright; no re-rotation was needed. Page 1 (title/address) and page 3 (signature) have no table rows.
